title: Paloma and the Promise Again
author: Jonah Yarrow
blurb: Gideon Okonkwo, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
